purpose: Identify a point, entity or status with a compact marker.
avoid: Do not encode identity solely by marker appearance.
basis: Native source page 2360:4844 (Marker), observed anatomy and examples.
openDecisions: Marker meaning, text equivalent, anchoring and static versus actionable usage.
profileRationale: Meaningful content or content container; not classified as decorative. Any interactive descendants need separate behavior and accessibility contracts.
